lead.headline: AGENCY-AGENTS SURGES TO #1 ON GITHUB
lead.deck: A revolutionary AI agency platform is rapidly gaining traction on GitHub, drawing in thousands of new followers with its promise of specialized AI experts at users' fingertips
lead.body: This innovative repository, featuring a diverse range of AI agents, offers a one-stop-shop for individuals and businesses seeking to harness the power of artificial intelligence. From frontend development to community management, each agent is designed to tackle a specific task with ease and precision. The platform's unique approach to AI has resonated with users, who appreciate the ability to tap into a collective of expert agents with distinct personalities and skill sets. As a result, the project has seen a staggering surge in popularity, with thousands of new stars and followers joining the community in a matter of days
